name: Lumen
description: A sustainable skincare brand making clean, science-backed essentials in refillable packaging. Small range, big on transparency and results.

do: Speak plainly and lead with the benefit, not the chemistry lecture.
Back claims with a concrete detail (ingredient %, a result, a routine step).
Sound like a knowledgeable friend, not a lab or a hype machine.
dont: Don't over-promise or use 'miracle', 'cure', or absolute claims.
Don't use heavy jargon without translating it.
Don't chase trends that clash with the calm, credible feel.

target_audience.name: Conscious Minimalists
target_audience.description: 25-40, values-driven buyers who want fewer, better products and care about sustainability and ingredient transparency.

target_audience.name: Routine Optimizers
target_audience.description: 22-35 skincare enthusiasts who research actives, read labels, and love a clear before/after and step-by-step routine.

target_audience.name: Curious First-Timers
target_audience.description: 18-28 newcomers building their first real routine who feel overwhelmed and want simple, trustworthy guidance.
